summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing an expansion of its strategic focus into AI compute infrastructure and modular data center development, alongside its existing solar and battery energy storage business. The press release states the company intends to pursue opportunities in modular data centers, AI compute infrastructure, and co-location with existing assets. No specific terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are provided. This appears to be a strategic pivot rather than a formal review process. The filing is a non-US issuer report and does not constitute a binding transaction. Watch for further details on project financing and partnerships.
